coins.name: Bitcoin
coins.role: The first and largest cryptocurrency. Often described as digital gold: a limited supply (21 million coins) and no company behind it.

coins.name: Ethereum
coins.role: A network that runs 'smart contracts': programs that other apps, tokens and stablecoins are built on. Its coin pays the fees.

coins.name: Tether
coins.role: A stablecoin meant to stay at $1, issued by Tether and backed by reserves the company reports. The most traded coin of all.

coins.name: BNB
coins.role: The coin of the BNB Chain, which began as the token of the Binance exchange. Used to pay fees on that network.

coins.name: USDC
coins.role: A stablecoin meant to stay at $1, issued by Circle and backed by cash and Treasury bills.

coins.name: XRP
coins.role: The coin of the XRP Ledger, designed for fast, cheap payments between banks and firms. Tied to the company Ripple.

coins.name: Solana
coins.role: A fast smart-contract network that competes with Ethereum. Known for low fees and for past outages.

coins.name: TRON
coins.role: A network heavily used to move stablecoins (especially USDT) between people and exchanges.

coins.name: Monero
coins.role: A privacy-focused coin that hides senders, receivers and amounts. Delisted from many exchanges because of that.

coins.name: Dogecoin
coins.role: Began as a joke in 2013. A 'meme coin': its value comes from attention and sentiment, not from any use.

coins.name: Chainlink
coins.role: Delivers outside data, such as prices, to smart contracts, which cannot look things up on their own.

coins.name: Cardano
coins.role: A smart-contract network built around academic research. Slower to ship than rivals, with a loyal community.

coins.name: Stellar
coins.role: A payments network aimed at cheap cross-border transfers and tokenized money.

coins.name: NEAR Protocol
coins.role: A smart-contract network focused on easy-to-use apps and low fees.

coins.name: Bitcoin Cash
coins.role: A 2017 split from Bitcoin that favors bigger blocks and cheap everyday payments.

coins.name: Dai
coins.role: A stablecoin meant to stay at $1, kept there by smart contracts and crypto collateral rather than a bank.

coins.name: Litecoin
coins.role: An early 'lighter' Bitcoin alternative from 2011, faster and cheaper but with far less use.

coins.name: Avalanche
coins.role: A smart-contract network that lets projects launch their own connected chains.

coins.name: Uniswap
coins.role: The governance token of Uniswap, a decentralized exchange where people trade tokens without a company in the middle.

coins.name: Sui
coins.role: A newer smart-contract network designed for fast, low-cost apps and games.

coins.name: Hedera
coins.role: The coin of Hedera, a network governed by a council of large companies.

coins.name: Shiba Inu
coins.role: A meme coin that began as a Dogecoin copycat. Value rests on attention.

coins.name: Aave
coins.role: The token of Aave, a lending market where people borrow and lend crypto using smart contracts.

coins.name: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund
Polkadot
coins.role: A network that connects separate blockchains so they can pass data and value to each other.

coins.name: Ethereum Classic
coins.role: The original Ethereum chain, which kept running after the 2016 split that created today's Ethereum.

coins.name: Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund
Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund

stocks.name: Strategy (MicroStrategy)
stocks.kind: Holds Bitcoin as its main asset
